surface_mechanism_description: The self-limiting mechanism was attributed to the adsorption of the MMA on the Ga surface, which prevents the adsorption of the excess TEG. The MMA species on the Ga surface were removed during the subsequent TDMAAs supply by the recombinations with the MMA species decomposed from the supplied TDMAAs.
evidence: The self-limiting mechanism was thus attributed to the adsorption of the MMA on the Ga surface, which prevents the adsorption of the excess TEG. The MMA species on the Ga surface were removed during the subsequent TDMAAs supply by the recombinations with the MMA species decomposed from the supplied TDMAAs.
